question: Estimate the annual revenue of OTT/video streaming platforms in India.
idealClarificationQuestions: Subscription revenue only or include ad-supported (AVOD) revenue? Both.
Include YouTube as OTT? Exclude YouTube to focus on Netflix/Prime/Hotstar/JioCinema/SonyLiv/Zee5.
Linear TV broadcasters' digital arm only or all platforms? All major OTTs.
Include sports rights and pay-per-view events? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Two-arm calculation: subscription revenue (paying users × ARPU) + ad revenue (active users × ad load × CPM equivalent).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Total OTT users in India: ~550M (any usage in past month, includes free-tier).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Average ARPU (blended across cheap mobile-only ₹49 packs to premium ₹1,500/yr): ~₹600/year.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: AVOD users: 430M free-tier users; average annual ad revenue per user ~₹150 (high-engagement events like cricket inflate this).

benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~550M (any usage in past month, includes free-tier).
~120M (households, not users — single subscription often shared by 4 people).
